title: Anima announces its G-Cloud 15 listing
summary: Read Anima’s G-Cloud 15 announcement and find out who to contact about procurement for your NHS organisation.
body_markdown:
On 17 September 2026, we announced that Anima is listed on G-Cloud 15. The announcement is for ICBs, federations, PCNs, practices and NHS trusts exploring how to procure Anima.


## Discuss your procurement plans


If your organisation is considering Anima, our team can discuss the relevant service, your requirements and the next steps for procurement.


[Contact the Anima team](https://www.animahealth.com/contact/sales)


[Review assurance and onboarding](https://www.animahealth.com/assurance-onboarding)
